epic.intent: Build comprehensive local-first API control of Windows Bannerlord + War Sails through a repo-reinstallable MCP server, in exactly one long sprint. Scope includes editor, scenes, terrain/navigation/foliage, resource authoring/import/publishing and shipping/runtime/server inspection and control. API feasibility across the whole kit is NOT certified by this plan: complete an operation-level inventory and prove routes before claiming coverage. UI-only/unavailable operations return explicit no-effect/unavailable results and remain uncovered; UI automation cannot substitute for required APIs. Keep all original source, reviewed pinned dependencies, licenses, configuration templates and build/install/repair/uninstall tooling in the repository; installed game/kit/proprietary assets remain declared local prerequisites. This chat creates/revises the researched plan only, without implementation or live probes.

successCriteria.text: A version-bound operation inventory reconciles the installed kit, official docs and managed/native registrations, with no hidden inventory gaps. Each operation has route, mode, owner and evidence status; no method-count or family-checkmark proxy for coverage.
A conformant pinned MCP host, editor/runtime/server adapters and bounded jobs expose correct schemas, mutation annotations, lifecycle-aware execution and truthful unavailable/error/recovery results.
Required scene/entity/prefab/terrain/foliage/navigation/road/river/presentation operations each demonstrate actual API effects and, for durable authoring, independent checks plus cold engine reload.

Required resource import/reimport/save/edit/bake/pack operations each demonstrate verified identity and intended-mode reload; runtime setters, callbacks, command strings and UI substitutes never stand in for durable authoring.
Required runtime campaign/mission/combat/animation/physics/naval/server inspection and control tools have independent observed effects, recovery and build/mode-specific evidence.

One final human sprint checkpoint verifies every required operation, no unresolved inventory gaps, existing-mod compatibility and clean alternate-checkout install/repair/reinstall/uninstall. All repository source/dependency inputs are reproducible; no hidden ignored-clone dependency.

bundle.rationale: Owner requested everything, local first with reusable architecture and repository reinstallability, one long sprint, planning only. Owner then challenged confidence and prioritized APIs with explicit no-effect for unavailable UI routes. Deeper REA distinguishes callbacks from save commands, undo registration from transactions, runtime setters from resource authoring, partial terrain/nav methods from complete editors, and generic dispatch/native strings from callable operations. Existing SDK code and one historical animation run provide bounded reuse, not 59 proven kit capabilities. Research tickets must reconcile operation inventory and prove direct routes before production contracts; all implementation tickets retain explicit evidence gates. No claim that all kit internals are already callable. Preserve one acceptance checkpoint and 40 mandatory work tickets; do not start execution.
